steps.en: An upload page is available next to the search form
steps.id: Halaman upload tersedia di samping form pencarian

steps.en: Officer fills a template with notice numbers
steps.id: Officer mengisi template dengan nomor notice

steps.en: Upload accepts spreadsheet files, not CSV
steps.id: Upload menerima file spreadsheet, bukan CSV
steps.why_en: The story says CSV but only XLSX files are accepted.
steps.why_id: Story menyebut CSV tetapi hanya file XLSX yang diterima.

steps.en: Every uploaded row is checked and searched
steps.id: Setiap baris yang diunggah diperiksa dan dicari

steps.en: Uploaded notices are listed on screen
steps.id: Notice dari upload ditampilkan di layar

steps.en: Uploaded notices can go on to revival
steps.id: Notice dari upload bisa lanjut ke revival
